stories.title: Tiny particles defy action-reaction symmetry to stay in motion
stories.desc: From schools of fish and flocks of birds to microscopic synthetic particles, many systems in nature and the laboratory consist of individual units or agents that move by consuming energy. These systems are known as active matter because their components continuously use energy to generate motion,…
